question: Has current-main handling from https://github.com/openclaw/clawsweeper/pull/849 produced a verified production delivery failure that outweighs the observed stale-publication retry churn?
rationale: The draft intentionally restores an earlier failure mode as a contingency, but the provided discussion contains no post-merge production evidence that the newer durable publication failed to deliver; choosing retry semantics is an operational policy decision.

options.title: Retain the terminal handoff
options.body: Keep the current-main behavior from https://github.com/openclaw/clawsweeper/pull/849 and close this fallback if no verified delivery failure is found.

options.title: Investigate a verified incident first
options.body: Keep this draft unmerged until redacted queue and publisher evidence shows that a superseded handoff leaves the final verdict undelivered, then replace the direct revert with a targeted recovery path.
